request.raw_text: Hi , Please remove the fillet at the front center and add a 1 millimeter chamfer instead

areas_to_change.action: Replace the existing fillet with a 1 millimeter chamfer.
areas_to_change.reference_geometry: The filleted edge or edge set at the center of the front (+Z) face.
areas_to_change.location: Front (+Z) side of the central hub, adjacent to the internally splined bore and its surrounding center feature.
areas_to_change.description: Remove the rounded transition at the front-center hub and apply a straight 1 mm chamfer to the same edge or edge set. The resulting transition should be planar and beveled rather than radiused.

areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve its tooth profile, diameter, axial alignment, depth, and fit-related geometry except where its front entrance edge is confirmed as the requested fillet.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Central hub and rear (-Z) center face
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the hub dimensions, scalloped surrounding profile, rear annular face, and all unrelated edge treatments.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Radial web, spokes, and lightening openings
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve all profiles, thicknesses, blends, spacing, and rotational arrangement.
Preserve the tooth count, tooth profiles, rim geometry, and existing edge treatments.
Do not alter the axial thickness, concentricity, or rotational symmetry of the component.

predicted_final_outcome.geometry: The selected rounded front-center edge transition is replaced by a 1 mm planar chamfer while the remainder of the sprocket-like component remains unchanged.
predicted_final_outcome.function: Provides a defined beveled lead-in or edge break at the front-center interface, potentially improving assembly guidance and edge clearance.
predicted_final_outcome.behavior: The central interface should retain its alignment and fit characteristics, with only a localized change from a smooth radius to a straight 1 mm bevel.

ambiguities.description: The phrase "fillet at the front center" does not uniquely identify an edge in the images.
candidate_interpretations: The circular or scalloped outer edge of the raised front-center hub.
The entrance edge of the internally splined central bore on the +Z face.
All filleted edges forming the front-center hub transition.

ambiguities.description: The chamfer definition gives only one value and does not state the dimensioning convention.
candidate_interpretations: A symmetric 1 mm by 45 degree chamfer.
A 1 mm face-distance chamfer using the CAD system default angle.
A chamfer with 1 mm equal distances on the two adjacent faces.
